title: Fix unconventional acknowledgements attribution
description: The Acknowledgements section (lines 266-268) credits Bron Gondwana for works he authored (JMAP-BLOBEXT, JMAP-FILENODE) without stating he contributed to this document. Standard IETF practice is to thank people for discussions, reviews, or specific contributions to the draft. Crediting someone for their own pre-existing works may imply endorsement they have not given. Revise to reflect actual contributions or discussions, if any, or remove.
